configurePresets.name: windows-base
configurePresets.description: Run from a VS Developer PowerShell so cl, clang-cl, llvm-rc, lld-link and ninja are on PATH. CMAKE_RC_COMPILER is llvm-rc for every Windows preset, MSVC included: the Windows SDK rc.exe is the only tool in this chain that is not long-path aware and fails with RC1109 under a deep build path. llvm-rc has no such limit, and this repo has no .rc files of its own, so it only ever compiles the manifest CMake generates. It ships with the same VS 'C++ Clang tools for Windows' component clang-cl comes from.

configurePresets.name: windows-clang-cl
configurePresets.description: The shipping configuration. Builds a measurably faster engine than MSVC while searching an identical tree - see issue #84. Use this for anything measured: Run-Bench and Run-EloMatch results are only comparable between binaries from the same compiler.

configurePresets.name: windows-clang-cl-debug
configurePresets.description: Engine changes should be checked here as well as in Release: Release passes some out-of-bounds reads silently.

configurePresets.name: windows-msvc
configurePresets.description: MSVC build, kept as a supported second toolchain for development and debugging, and because it honours flags clang-cl accepts and silently drops. It is NOT what ships, so do not measure with it: an MSVC candidate against a clang reference reads as a large phantom regression.

configurePresets.name: windows-msvc-debug
configurePresets.description: MSVC Debug. The closest equivalent to the retired .vcxproj Debug configuration.
